_doctrine: THE RULE BOX (Palle: 'a factory making a pearl necklace, artifact as input, footprint as decoration, plus additional parameters we can change'). Every map strategy is the SAME factory with different rules per stage: string (the mission order) -> pearl (footprint becomes plate/room/segment) -> thread (how pearls lie in space) -> opening (how the between is made) -> dress (staffing, palettes, props via map_principal.finish). A recipe names the strategy tool + the knobs to turn. Run: python tools/pearl_factory.py --recipe=<name> [--seq=..] [--seed=..] [--set KNOB=value]

stages.string: mission beats + voltage from doc/book/baselines/<seq>.json (fixed for all recipes)
stages.pearl: the decoration: footprint -> plate (ants) | room+aisle (rooms/antrooms/flock/physarum) | segment width (wanghall) | tight plate beside path (derive)
stages.thread: the layout: serpentine bands (rooms) | one axis (wanghall) | max-min scatter (ants/antrooms/physarum) | drift walk (derive) | boids (flock)
stages.opening: the between: carved doors (rooms) | continuous floor (wanghall) | wander trails (ants) | A*-over-noise (antrooms) | return-pass shortcuts (derive) | slime trunks (physarum) | gates+L-corridors (flock)
stages.dress: map_principal.finish: labwall + register palettes + proximity_lod + wall runs + wall props + supporting cast (benches by register quota)

recipes_note: THE BOX IS FULL - 13 strategies, every one seeded-deterministic, pathfinder-gated, sliderable

lsystem.note: the grammar grows the map: turtle path = corridor skeleton, beat rooms at branch tips in derivation order, chapels on side twigs

dla.note: rooms as aggregation seeds; seeded walkers stick into dendritic corridors (110 default - screening physics over-grows at 900); A*-over-noise repairs, tips pruned

wfc.note: the original 8x8 wang blocks, wave-function-collapsed: beats pinned on a serpentine spine, min-entropy collapse with register weights, spanning-tree unseal guarantees the walk (seed-swept 10/10)

voronoi.note: beat sites tessellate territories; walls on every territory meeting edge (the wang move); doors where beat-order neighbours touch, L-corridors where they do not

rd.note: Gray-Scott floor: spots=arrival, stripes=work, sparse=depth; A* repairs join what the chemistry missed

erosion.note: noise heightfield; valleys = least-cost water routes between plateau rooms; berm banks flank the cut (flat walk — wp is the only ramp the pathfinder knows)

halls.note: three register act-halls; features fill; chapels the only enclosed rooms

rooms.note: per-beat sized rooms, serpentine bands with turns

wanghall.note: ONE breathing hall; widths pulse wide(14-18)/narrow(10); voltage = width-8 pinches

ants.note: footprint plates; ants find the floor; pheromone >= THRESHOLD becomes the plate (2 = only well-trodden paths)

knobs.REUSE: 0.35 — cost discount on carved floor (lower = more trunk merging)

antrooms.note: perfect but close rooms; ants OPEN the space between with A*-over-noise; reuse discount merges trunks (proven 2.8x)

derive.note: the wanderer with the backpack; forward places, the return improves (tightest of all: 385/471 cells)

flock.note: rooms as boids; separation = honest spacing, sequence-cohesion clusters the walk (tightest maps: 721/884 cells)

physarum.note: slime trunks between sealed rooms; corridor width follows flow (trunk 4-wide / twig 2-wide)
